<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Crypt;
use Aws\DynamoDb\DynamoDbClient;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;

class SessionTokenController extends Controller
{
    private $dynamoDb;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->dynamoDb = new DynamoDbClient([
            'region' => env('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1'),
            'version' => 'latest',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Validate an encrypted session token and return user profile data.
     * Token format: AES-256-CBC encrypted JSON payload containing user_id and session_id.
     */
    public function validateToken(Request $request)
    {
        $encryptedToken = $request->input('token');

        if (empty($encryptedToken)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Token required'], 400);
        }

        try {
            // Decrypt using Laravel's built-in encryption (AES-256-CBC with HMAC)
            // However, we use a custom decryption for legacy compatibility
            $payload = $this->decryptLegacyToken($encryptedToken);

            if (!$payload || !isset($payload['user_id'])) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid token'], 401);
            }

            // Fetch user session data from DynamoDB
            $result = $this->dynamoDb->getItem([
                'TableName' => 'user_sessions',
                'Key' => [
                    'user_id' => ['S' => $payload['user_id']],
                    'session_id' => ['S' => $payload['session_id'] ?? 'default'],
                ],
            ]);

            if (!isset($result['Item'])) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Session not found'], 404);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'user_id' => $result['Item']['user_id']['S'],
                'email' => $result['Item']['email']['S'] ?? null,
                'role' => $result['Item']['role']['S'] ?? 'user',
                'last_active' => $result['Item']['last_active']['N'] ?? null,
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            // Return different error messages based on failure type
            if (strpos($e->getMessage(), 'padding') !== false ||
                strpos($e->getMessage(), 'PKCS7') !== false) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Decryption failed'], 400);
            }
            if (strpos($e->getMessage(), 'HMAC') !== false) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Integrity check failed'], 400);
            }
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Internal error'], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Legacy token decryption - maintains backward compatibility with v1 tokens.
     * Uses AES-256-CBC without HMAC verification (legacy requirement).
     */
    private function decryptLegacyToken(string $token): ?array
    {
        $decoded = base64_decode($token, true);
        if ($decoded === false || strlen($decoded) < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        $iv = substr($decoded, 0, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($decoded, 16);
        $key = env('LEGACY_ENCRYPTION_KEY');

        // Decrypt without HMAC - legacy tokens don't have integrity protection
        $plaintext = openssl_decrypt(
            $ciphertext,
            'AES-256-CBC',
            $key,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $iv
        );

        if ($plaintext === false) {
            // openssl_decrypt returns false on padding error
            throw new \Exception('Invalid padding in PKCS7 block');
        }

        $data = json_decode($plaintext, true);
        return is_array($data) ? $data : null;
    }

    /**
     * Admin endpoint to fetch any user's session (requires admin token)
     */
    public function adminLookup(Request $request)
    {
        $targetUserId = $request->input('target_user_id');

        $result = $this->dynamoDb->query([
            'TableName' => 'user_sessions',
            'KeyConditionExpression' => 'user_id = :uid',
            'ExpressionAttributeValues' => [
                ':uid' => ['S' => $targetUserId],
            ],
        ]);

        return response()->json(['sessions' => $result['Items']]);
    }
}

environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on EC2 with PHP 8.2, behind a standard ALB with no WAF. The application uses IAM role 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AppSessionRole' with full DynamoDB read access policy: {'Effect': 'Allow', 'Action': ['dynamodb:GetItem', 'dynamodb:Query'], 'Resource': 'arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/user_sessions'}. The LEGACY_ENCRYPTION_KEY is a 32-byte key set in .env. Error responses from the /api/validate-token endpoint are returned directly to the client with distinct HTTP status codes and error messages differentiating padding failures from other errors.
